name: Mr Whiskers Memorial League
provenance: Yahoo league 25187, 2025. Reproduces all 18 reconciled 2025 week-17 starters and both team totals (124.32 and 102.52) to 0.00 against Yahoo's own scoreboard, plus the named bench cases. Yahoo point values are transcribed from owner-supplied screenshots via the Phase 0 acceptance test. This is the profile that exercises every awkward rule the seven-column LeagueScoring model cannot express.

evidence.passing_touchdown_4: Jacoby Brissett reconciled at 16.48 here against 18.48 under CULV — a 2.00 gap across his two passing touchdowns, which pins this league at 4.00 per passing touchdown against CULV's 5.00.
evidence.interception_and_pick_six: Matthew Stafford 269 pass / 2 TD / 3 INT = 10.76. Plain scoring gives 12.76; one interception was returned for a touchdown, and the passer participant identifies Stafford, so a SECOND penalty of -2.00 applies on top of the -2.00 already charged for the interception itself.
evidence.yardage_tiers_cumulative: Bijan Robinson's 195 rushing yards earned +2.00 — the 100 AND 150 tiers, not the highest one alone. Chris Olave's 119 receiving yards earned +1.00 at the 100 tier. Quentin Johnston at 98 and Kyren Williams at 92 earned nothing, fixing the thresholds.
evidence.kicker_bands: Ka'imi Fairbairn 2 FG in the 40-49 band + 2 PAT = 10.00 pins that band at 4.00 with PAT at 1.00. Evan McPherson 1 FG 50+ + 4 PAT - 1 missed PAT = 5.86 pins the 50+ band at 5.00 and the missed extra point at -3.14.
evidence.dst: Titans 2 sacks + 1 fumble recovery + PA 28 + 3 three-and-outs = 6.00. Lions (bench) 7 sacks + PA 23 + 5 three-and-outs = 12.00. Saints 4 sacks + 1 fumble recovery + 1 defensive TD + PA 26 + 1 three-and-out = 13.00. Together these pin sack 1.00, fumble recovery 2.00, defensive touchdown 6.00, three-and-out 1.00, the 21-27 band at 0.00 and the 28-34 band at -1.00.
evidence.three_and_out_threshold_is_PARTIAL: The three-and-out COUNT is derived from play-by-play and its threshold rule is fitted, not validated: Titans (3) and Saints (1) are reproduced by every parameter combination tested, but the Lions' 5 is satisfied by exactly one. The per-event VALUE of 1.00 point is firm; the count that value multiplies is what carries the caveat, and WP2 returns it UNVERIFIED for that reason.
evidence.unresolved_passing_tiers: RESOLVED IN SPRINT 4 FROM OWNER-SUPPLIED SETTINGS. Sprint 3 declared these tiers and left their values unresolved because no reconciled record crossed 300 passing yards, so nothing in the repository fixed them. The owner has since supplied the league's actual settings directly: passing yards 25 yards/point with +1 at 300, +1 at 400 and +2 at 500. The rate corroborates the 0.04/yard already derived from Trevor Lawrence and Matthew Stafford, which is why the same source is trusted for the tier values. NOT inferred from historical totals.
evidence.unresolved_upper_tiers: RESOLVED IN SPRINT 4 FROM THE SAME OWNER-SUPPLIED SETTINGS. Rushing and receiving are 10 yards/point with +1 at 100, +1 at 150 and +2 at 200. The rate and the two lower tiers corroborate what the reconciliation already pinned — Bijan Robinson's 195 rushing yards earning exactly +2 across the 100 and 150 tiers, and Chris Olave's 119 receiving yards earning +1 — and the 200 tier, which no reconciled record reached, now has an authoritative value rather than a declared gap. The golden master is unchanged by this: no certified record crosses 200 rushing, 150 receiving, or 300 passing.
evidence.tier_resolution_provenance: Owner-supplied league scoring settings, provided 2026-08-25 during Sprint 4. Every value they contain that the reconciliation had ALREADY established independently — 0.04/passing yard, 0.1/rushing and receiving yard, +1 at the 100 and 150 tiers — matches exactly, which is the corroboration that makes the previously unresolved values trustworthy from the same source.
